Noah: Noticed the stream jittered around slide 9; viewers reporting frozen frame + audio ok. Can streaming ops triage and advise on handling any missed Qs?
ops-bot: Incident logged AH-3420001111. Snapshot available at s3://redwood-recordings/ah/3420001111/snapshots.zip
Sana: On it. Switched to hot-standby encoder at +90s, continued the stream. We have a ~30s hole in the main recording. Uploading the partial: https://internal.redwood/recordings/3420001111/partA.mp4
Priya: Leadership FYI 10:05 in the deck we called out roadmap timing. Should we repeat that section in the follow-up or record a short clip to append?
Marco: Quick debug: encoder crashed due to GPU driver OOM when slide deck had animated PNG. Restarted driver and disabled hw overlay. Commands used:
```
sudo systemctl restart nvidia-persistenced
export LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1
```
Eve: Studio recorded clean multi-track audio; video only affected. I can sync audio to the standby video and render a patched file by 17:30 PT.
Jules: For Q&A handling: I copied live questions from the Q&A doc into #all-hands-qa. Suggest we answer top 3 live questions during Friday's closing 10-min segment and post written answers for the rest.
Noah: Sounds good. Sana/Eve confirm ETA + deliverable? Also tag any customer-facing folks for follow up.
Sana: ETA for patched render: today 17:30 PT. I'll post final link and notes. Posting to #support with timestamps now.
Eve: Confirmed 17:30 PT deliverable: patched video + iso audio, with README of edits.
Priya: I'll reserve 10 min in Friday's all-hands for a short recap and Q&A. Please DM me any priority Qs.
Marco: Opened ticket STREAM-9122 with driver logs and mitigation steps. I'll add recommended guardrails for animated assets.
Noah: Thanks all. Action list: 1) Sana/Eve deliver patched file by 17:30 PT, 2) Sana to post support note with timestamps, 3) Priya to add 10-min recap on Friday, 4) Marco to own post-incident follow-up.
Sana: Support note posted: https://internal.redwood/support/ah-3420001111 (tagging @support).
Noah: Great. If anything else, ping me. :raised_hands:
